notes.title: Brand new update for Recycling Center Simulator! ♻️
notes.content:
[b][h2]January QoL Update is here ♻️[/h2][/b]

[h3]New year new us, and do we have some exciting news for you! As we announced in one of our previous posts, our brand new QoL update just dropped, and what an update it is! Inventory sheet, so you can track your products in storage, new contract filters to make finding offers even easier, early loan payments so you can spend that cash overflow.[/h3]

There is still more that this update has to offer. Bug fixes for the flashlight being pesky in minigames (somebody was clearly holding that flashlight wrong), the lockpicks should now behave consistently, and Send message button will no longer keep growing, because at some point it had to. 
[b]Check out what exactly we have in store for you this time, and remember to look over our Update Plan in our previous post, to see what’s ahead for Recycling Center Simulator.[/b]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44981885/e88f3ea53d32078132c22c8049589a56e0fd47c3.png[/img]


[b]v1.3. WHAT'S NEW? 🔥[/b]
•    From now on, you can cancel your contracts with paying cancelation fee.
•    Inventory sheet! From now on you can keep track of your products in your storage with inventory sheet! (Use Tab or R3 to open)
•    New contract filters to find suitable offers more faster and easier!
•    From now on, you can put sorted waste boxes to the pallets!
•    Early payment option for loans.


[b]BUG FIXES 🔧[/b]
•    Fixed flashlight overexposure issues in lockpicking and crowbar minigames.
•    Trucks' body colliders revised.
•    Waste spawn areas in collection sites revised.
•    Fixed an issue that causes lockpick to rotate strangely.
•    Send message button in bargain panel gets bigger bug has fixed.
•    Colliders in some areas revised.

[h3][b]That’s not all! To celebrate the update, the game is now on sale! You can check all those changes out for yourself and play the new update over here right now! [/b][/h3]

Let us know what you think, and remember, we still have plenty of content in store for you.
Happy recycling,

notes.title: 🚨 New Update Alert for Recycling Center Simulator! 🚨
notes.content:
We’ve got some awesome news for all of you today! Our latest update has just dropped, and we’re finally bringing you something you’ve been asking for… Gamepad support! 🎮 Yes, that’s right! No more fiddling with a mouse and keyboard if you’re a controller enthusiast. Plug in your gamepad and dive right into the recycling madness!

[b]We’ve also got a sneak peek at our Update Plan for the upcoming months. Here's what you can expect:[/b]

📅 January — QoL  & Bug Fixes 🔧
📅 February — Major Update: Hybrid Production ⚡
📅 March — QoL & Bug Fixes (again, because we love making things smoother)
📅 April — Bio Gas DLC (get ready to turn waste into energy! ♻️)

Here's a little sneak peek of February's update:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44981885/de0a0c24756199893b76c2324a47128e1b6c6915.gif[/img]

So yeah, the recycling future looks bright, and we’re just getting started! Keep your eyes peeled for all the cool stuff coming soon. 🦾

We want to hear from you! Got any ideas or suggestions for future updates? Think we can make recycling even more awesome? Drop your thoughts in the comments or hit us up on social media! We love hearing from you, even if it's just a "hey, can you make a cardboard robot?" 🤖

Stay tuned and keep those gamepads charged, because we’ve got some exciting stuff coming your way. And remember, the only thing more satisfying than recycling is recycling in style. 😎

Happy recycling! ♻️

Happy Recycling
Recycling Team

[h3][b]That’s why we need your help! 🙏[/b][/h3]

Please let us know in the comments if you’ve encountered this issue. [b]If so, share your PC specs (processor, graphics card, RAM) and the antivirus software you’re using. 🖥️🔐 [/b] Your feedback could be crucial in helping us solve this issue.

Your involvement in this community has always been incredible, and we know we can count on you once again! 💪 Every bit of information you provide brings us closer to resolving the problem. You're not just players – you're a vital part of the development process, and we couldn’t do this without you! ❤️
[h3][b]Thank you so much for your support – you’re the best![/b][/h3]


Recycling Center Simulator Team

notes.title: Approaching Demo Day – New Area: Supermarket, Sales System and More
notes.content:
[b]Hello recyclers![/b]

We are excited to share the latest progress on "Recycling Center Simulation" as we approach the demo day on June 10th. Here’s what we’ve accomplished this week:

[previewyoutube=aD5QadYtsLM;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]
[b]1.Supermarket Area Designed:[/b]

We have designed a new area, the supermarket. Players can access this site via Scrap Deals. Upon visiting, they can collect various recyclable materials, adding a new layer of exploration and resource gathering to the game.




[b]2. Sales System Completed:[/b]

We are thrilled to introduce our brand-new sales system! Now, you can dive into the trading aspect of the game by accessing the in-game computer. Open the sales app and discover NPCs eagerly waiting to purchase your recycled materials. Whether you have the items in stock or need to embark on a quest to collect and process them, this system brings a whole new level of strategic gameplay. Negotiate deals, fulfill demands, and watch your profits soar with every successful transaction!

[b]3.Storage System Finished:[/b]

The storage system is now fully functional. Players can view their inventory, seeing which materials are available in the storage area. This helps in managing resources effectively and planning the next steps.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44981885/da8b1ca645f41cd6e8db23975ee738b39ef09715.gif[/img]

Stay tuned for more updates as we get closer to the demo launch. Don’t forget to wishlist the game on Steam to stay up to date with all the news and developments!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44981885/087b4c2f2fbe6be370cb79bb4737a12f8e5c42e1.png[/img]

notes.title: Major Milestones Reached in Recycling Center Simulation!

[b]2. NPC Dialogues:[/b] All NPC dialogues for buying and selling interactions are complete and packed with personality. These conversations will add depth and dynamism to your trading experiences, making every transaction feel unique and engaging.

[b]3. Game Economy:[/b] Our game economy is fully functional and nearly optimized! We’ve meticulously balanced the financial aspects to ensure a challenging yet rewarding economic journey. Prepare to master the market!

[b]4. Factory Design:[/b] The recycling center's factory design is now complete, and it looks fantastic! We've crafted a functional and visually appealing industrial space where you'll build your recycling empire from the ground up.

And the best part? [b]The demo[/b] for 'Recycling Center Simulation' will be  [u][b]available on the 10th of June[/b][/u]   on Steam! Mark your calendars, spread the word, and don’t forget to wishlist us on Steam to stay updated on all the exciting developments.

notes.title: Exciting New Features and Progress in Recycling Center Simulation!

[b]1. Item Expansion:[/b] We've added a whopping 90 new items that you can collect and recycle! Each item brings unique challenges and benefits, significantly expanding the gameplay possibilities.

[b]2.Pallet Jack Introduction:[/b] Moving heavy items around your recycling center has never been easier! We’ve designed and coded the pallet jack, a crucial tool for efficiently transporting pallets across the facility.

[b]3. Sorting Mini-Game:[/b] We're excited to introduce a fun, optional mini-game for sorting the materials you collect. This addition not only enhances gameplay but also gives you more control over how you manage your recycling operations.

[b]4.Advanced Machinery:[/b] Our team has been hard at work finalizing the purchase and implementation of new machines that allow for more complex recycling processes. These machines are key to expanding your recycling capabilities.

[b]5.Level 2 Machines Complete:[/b] All Level 2 machines are now fully operational! These advanced machines enable you to process recyclables more efficiently and unlock new ways to profit from your hard-earned scraps.

[previewyoutube=IQOXGkMDTVQ;full][/previewyoutube]

We’re thrilled to share these updates with you and look forward to your feedback. Don’t forget, [b]the demo [/b]for 'Recycling Center Simulation' will be ready on the [b]10th of June! [/b]Stay tuned for more enhancements and surprises as we continue to build a comprehensive and engaging recycling simulator. Don’t forget to wishlist 'Recycling Center Simulation' to keep up with all our updates!

Happy Recycling!

— The Balas Games Team
